history.summary: New role dhcp_probe on srviac's site.yml play: a 3-min systemd timer sends a relay-style DISCOVER (giaddr 10.1.0.45, UDP 67) to 10.2.1.10 and writes dhcp_probe_success / dhcp_probe_last_run_timestamp_seconds / dhcp_probe_duration_seconds {server="10.2.1.10"} to node-exporter's textfile dir. Witnessed once from srviac under the unit's sandboxing (OFFER 10.1.1.80 in 3.004 s, dnsmasq logged it); ansible and root gates green; applying the play stays the operator's.
ansible: cexec iac poetry run ansible-lint    [  OK  ]

The dhcp_probe role meets P1's outcome. It runs a 3-min relay-style DISCOVER from srviac to 10.2.1.10 and records success, duration and timestamp through node-exporter's textfile collector. giaddr renders to 10.1.0.45 and the unit tests pass. One advisory finding: check mode skips the timer task.

findings.summary: dhcp_probe's timer enable/start task is skipped under --check on every run, so dry runs never show the timer's state or its drift
